Name: Content Patcher - Playable Ocarinas
Author: Mushroomyx
Description:
This mod adds 7 ocarinas to the game in the colors Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, Orange and Cyan. With these you can either play a song with your Keyboard,  or play a MIDI File.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551/]Playable Piano[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to obtain[/size]
During the Flower Dance, Pierre will be selling two color variations for 2000G.

[size=5]How to Use[/size]
for further Information on how to play songs, please check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551/]Playable Piano[/url] Modpage

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.11 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and split-screen mode.
[*]Multiplayer only works with some base game sounds
[/list]
